verses.pali: “Ānāpānassati, bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṁsā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, when mindfulness of breathing is developed and cultivated it’s very fruitful and beneficial.

verses.pali: Kathaṁ bhāvitā ca, bhikkhave, ānāpānassati kathaṁ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṁsā?
verses.english: And how is mindfulness of breathing developed and cultivated to be very fruitful and beneficial?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ānāpānassatisahagataṁ satisambojjhaṅgaṁ bhāveti vivekanissitaṁ virāganissitaṁ nirodhanissitaṁ vossaggapariṇāmiṁ,
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant develops mindfulness of breathing together with the awakening factors of mindfulness,
investigation of principles, energy, rapture, tranquility, immersion,

verses.pali: ānāpānassatisahagataṁ upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṁ bhāveti vivekanissitaṁ virāganissitaṁ nirodhanissitaṁ vossaggapariṇāmiṁ.
verses.english: and equanimity, which rely on seclusion, fading away, and cessation, and ripen as letting go.

verses.pali: Evaṁ bhāvitā kho, bhikkhave, ānāpānassati evaṁ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṁsā”ti.
verses.english: Mindfulness of breathing, when developed and cultivated in this way, is very fruitful and beneficial.”
